passages.text: If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence, as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil, to make Your name known to Your enemies, so that the nations will tremble at Your presence!
passages.sermon:
God is powerful.
God rules over all creation.
If only You would tear open the heavens.
If only You would come down.
Your presence would make the mountains shake.
Fire burns brushwood quickly.
Fire makes water boil.
In the same way, Your presence brings great change.
You would make Your name known to Your enemies.
Nations would tremble before You.
passages.original: לוּא־ קָרַ֤עְתָּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃ כִּקְדֹ֧חַ אֵ֣שׁ הֲמָסִ֗ים מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה־ אֵ֔שׁ לְהוֹדִ֥יעַ שִׁמְךָ֖ לְצָרֶ֑יךָ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ׃

passages.text: When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.
passages.sermon:
God did awesome works.
We did not expect these works.
God came down.
The mountains trembled at God's presence.
passages.original: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃

passages.text: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
passages.sermon:
God is unique.
No other god is like Him.
From the beginning of time, no one has heard of another god like Him.
No ear has ever listened and understood a god like Him.
No eye has ever seen a god like Him.
God acts for those who wait for Him.
He helps those who trust in Him.
passages.original: וּמֵעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־ רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You welcome those who gladly do right, who remember Your ways. Surely You were angry, for we sinned. How can we be saved if we remain in our sins?
passages.sermon:
God welcomes people who do what is right with joy.
God welcomes people who remember His ways.
God became angry.
We sinned.
We sinned for a long time.
We cannot be saved if we stay in our sins.
passages.original: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת־ שָׂשׂ֙ וְעֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק בִּדְרָכֶ֖יךָ יִזְכְּר֑וּךָ הֵן־ אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֙פְתָּ֙ וַֽנֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּהֶ֥ם עוֹלָ֖ם וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
passages.sermon:
All of us have become unclean.
All our righteous acts are like filthy rags.
We all wither like a leaf.
Our sins carry us away like the wind.
passages.original: וַנְּהִ֤י כַטָּמֵא֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וּכְבֶ֥גֶד עִדִּ֖ים כָּל־ צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַנָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽעָלֶה֙ כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַעֲוֺנֵ֖נוּ כָּר֥וּחַ יִשָּׂאֻֽנוּ׃

passages.text: No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord.
God has hidden His face from us.
No one calls on God's name.
No one tries to hold on to God.
God has given us over to our sins.
Our sins control us.
passages.original: וְאֵין־ קוֹרֵ֣א בְשִׁמְךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְהַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵ֖נוּ בְּיַד־ עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our Father.
He shapes us.
We are like clay.
He is the potter.
He forms us.
We are all the work of His hand.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ אָ֑תָּה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔נוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are our God and our Father.
Do not be angry with us beyond measure.
Do not remember our sins forever.
Look at us now.
We are all Your people.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהוָה֙ עַד־ מְאֹ֔ד וְאַל־ לָעַ֖ד תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט־ נָ֖א עַמְּךָ֥ כֻלָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
passages.sermon:
God, You are our Father.
You are holy.
You chose Jerusalem and Zion as Your special cities.
Your holy cities have become a wilderness.
Zion has become a wasteland.
Jerusalem is now a desolation.
passages.original: עָרֵ֥י קָדְשְׁךָ֖ הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ מִדְבָּ֣ר הָיָ֔תָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁמָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
passages.sermon:
Our temple was holy and beautiful.
Our fathers praised You there.
Fire has burned this temple.
Everything precious to us is now in ruins.
passages.original: בֵּ֧ית קָדְשֵׁ֣נוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּ֗נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִֽלְל֙וּךָ֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הָיָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְכָל־ מַחֲמַדֵּ֖ינוּ הָיָ֥ה לְחָרְבָּֽה׃

passages.text: After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are the God of Israel.
You see all that has happened to us.
Our holy cities have become a wilderness.
Zion has become a wasteland.
Jerusalem is a desolation.
Our holy and beautiful temple is burned with fire.
Everything dear to us lies in ruins.
After all this, will You restrain Yourself, O LORD?
Will You keep silent?
Will You afflict us beyond measure?
passages.original: הַעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה תִתְאַפַּ֖ק יְהוָ֑ה תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה וּתְעַנֵּ֖נוּ עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃ס
